title: Crispy Fried Rice
description: A simple and delicious Vietnamese-inspired dish made with fried rice, perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the fried rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the chopped scallions and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the soy sauce (if using) and stir-fry for a further minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
